name: Sinus surgery
summary: How expats evaluate functional endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS) and related procedures in Singapore — after meds and allergy care fail, and what recovery feels like in humid haze seasons.
body:
Chronic sinusitis that survives sprays, saline, and allergy management may land in ENT surgical counselling. Functional endoscopic sinus surgery opens blocked pathways; balloon and polyp pathways get discussed case-by-case.

## Before the OR
- Confirm CT correlation with symptoms (not scan-only surgery)
- Optimise allergy/asthma control
- Review prior sprays, antibiotics, and oral steroid courses
- Discuss smell loss expectations honestly
- Map work travel — flying soon after surgery needs clearance

Acute complications (orbital/severe headache, vision change) are emergencies, not elective clinic delays.

## Recovery in Singapore
Humidity and haze can irritate healing mucosa; follow saline irrigation schedules. Nose-blowing bans are real — ask about return-to-gym and scuba timing. Insurance pre-auth often needs chronic-sinus documentation.

## How to choose
Prefer ENTs who show your CT, explain which sinuses are targeted, and outline revision risk. Be wary of cash packages sold the same day as a first visit without imaging review.

## Practical tip
Buy the exact rinse bottles recommended before surgery day. Set calendar reminders for irrigations — consistency beats fancy gadgets.
